say:2:1720707001:1.text: Gwyneth, can we hang out in town today? You deserve a break!

say:10:1720707006:1.text: Phew... that's a relief. Since we're all here, how about we explore Savannah together? I've been cooped up in the palace all this time and hardly had any chance to see the city...
say:10:1720707006:1.source_cn: 呼……那就好。大家难得聚在一起，不如我们一起去逛逛赛凡...

say:11:1720707007:1.text: I'd love to join you, but I have to train the new recruits at the base...
say:11:1720707007:1.source_cn: 佩吉，我也很想陪你，但守备军驻地的新兵们还在等着我去训练……

say:12:1720707008:1.text: ... Alright then, I'll just head out by myself!
say:12:1720707008:1.source_cn: ……那好吧，我一个人也可以出去玩！
